A '''hunting rifle''' was a personal weapon which could be used to [[Hunting/Legends|hunt]] small game. They were often part of the emergency supply cache aboard [[lifeboat]]s.<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> The [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Big game hunter/Legends|hunter]] [[Jombo]] carried a hunting rifle while accompanying [[Gamgalon]]'s [[Morodin/Legends|Morodin]]-hunting [[Gamgalon's Morodin-hunting safari|safaris]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Varonat/Legends|Varonat]].<ref name="FC" />
